title: The Smart Speaker
narration: My smart speaker played a recording of my husband planning my murder. When I confronted him, it played my voice helping with the plan. Neither of us remembered speaking. A third voice—our counsellor—ordered us to repeat the scheme until we believed it. We discovered four of his former couples had died in apparent murder-suicides, and our medicine labels had been switched. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. The speaker declared the session complete as my husband received an order to begin the final exercise and locked the kitchen.
